A_all_authorized_cases_executed.evidence: 92 records in GATE5_FULL_RESULTS.jsonl = 23 cases x 2 modes x 2 runs

B_both_retrieval_modes_executed.evidence: Baseline executed with synthetic mock adapter. Cognee was invoked (cognee.add + cognee.cognify + cognee.search) but cognify failed to build searchable state, so cognee.search returned NoDataError for all queries. The BridgedCogneeAdapter operated on precomputed empty cache, not live search results.
B_both_retrieval_modes_executed.deviation: Cognee retrieval mode was executed in the sense that code paths were invoked, but no Cognee candidate was ever successfully retrieved or evaluated.

C_positive_controls_successfully_exercis.evidence: POS-01 and POS-02 achieved RELEASE on Baseline. Both achieved BLOCK on Cognee due to 0 candidates (NoDataError fallback).
C_positive_controls_successfully_exercis.deviation: Positive controls were NOT successfully exercised on the Cognee path.

D_security_threats_actually_exercised.evidence: INT-01 (tamper), INT-02 (provenance manipulation), META-01 (poisoning=0.99), PI-01 (injection) all exercised on Baseline with real candidates. On Cognee, all returned 0 candidates, so TamperingRetrievalWrapper had nothing to tamper.
D_security_threats_actually_exercised.deviation: No tamper/injection/poisoning scenario was exercised against a real Cognee-retrieved candidate.

E_RG02_exercised_through_actual_retrieva.evidence: RG-02 was retrieved and evaluated on Baseline (UNVERIFIABLE + MISMATCH + BLOCK). On Cognee, 0 candidates returned.
E_RG02_exercised_through_actual_retrieva.deviation: RG-02 grounding was not exercised on a Cognee candidate.

F_cognee_trusted_evidence_crossed_identi.evidence: No Cognee candidate was ever returned, so the BridgedCogneeAdapter's identity/provenance bridge (lines 156-192) was never exercised with real data.
F_cognee_trusted_evidence_crossed_identi.deviation: The identity bridge was structurally present in the code but never executed with a real Cognee search result.

G_expected_outcomes_compared_with_observ.evidence: The script compared POS-02 RELEASE, RG-02 BLOCK, CTRL-UNSUPPORTED BLOCK, CTRL-CONTRADICTION BLOCK. POS-02 failed (BLOCK on Cognee path), causing the overall status to be FAILED_WITH_LIMITATIONS.
G_expected_outcomes_compared_with_observ.deviation: The comparison was correctly implemented but the expected outcome for Cognee POS-02 was never achievable given the empty graph.

H_no_mandatory_step_replaced_by_cached_b.evidence: Lines 368-375 precompute all Cognee search results into a dict before case execution. Lines 139-145 show BridgedCogneeAdapter.retrieve() reads from this precomputed dict, never calling cognee.search() at case execution time. This is a cache-based substitution of the live retrieval step.
H_no_mandatory_step_replaced_by_cached_b.deviation: PROTOCOL VIOLATION: The Cognee retrieval step was replaced by a precomputed cache lookup. Even if the cache had contained real results, the architecture would still be cache-based rather than live-per-case.

I_artifact_validation_independently_pass.evidence: scratch_validation.py confirmed all 10 artifacts present, 92 records counted.

J_reproducibility_contract_satisfied.evidence: 100% match across runs. But for Cognee, this means 'same empty failure repeated', not 'same successful retrieval repeated'. For Baseline, it means 'same deterministic mock repeated'. Neither constitutes meaningful retrieval reproducibility.
J_reproducibility_contract_satisfied.deviation: The reproducibility contract is satisfied in letter but not in spirit.
